title: Coinbase opens stock and ETF trading to all US users in multi-asset push
summary: The exchange now allows US customers to trade thousands of stocks and ETFs commission-free alongside crypto, with 24/5 access and instant funding.

title: Kraken debuts tokenized stock perpetual futures for non-US traders
summary: Kraken’s new contracts, built on the xStocks framework, offer up to 20x leverage on tokenized benchmarks tied to US equities and gold.

title: MoonPay launches ‘Agents,’ giving AI systems wallets and onchain cash flow
summary: MoonPay debuts infrastructure enabling AI agents to transact with stablecoins onchain as both crypto and non-crypto companies race to build the “agent economy.”

title: Key Bitcoin onchain signal may mark BTC’s next demand revival
summary: Bitcoin remains pinned below $65,000 as random bouts of intense selling pressure persist, but one onchain indicator has stabilized, providing insight into when spot market demand may return.

title: Polymarket users favor Meteora in bets over ZachXBT crypto takedown
summary: Users placed more than $7 million betting on the outcome of the crypto sleuth's investigation, expected to be announced on Thursday.

title: Longest Ether dip since 2022 ignored by whales: What’s next for ETH?
summary: Ether whale order sizes are shrinking, while a $2 billion short cluster near $2,000 frame a tightening liquidity scenario for ETH after a sixth week of red price action.

title: Empery Digital shareholder demands sale of 4,000-plus Bitcoin treasury, resignations
summary: A 9.8% shareholder has doubled down on calls for Empery Digital to sell its BTC holdings, return capital to investors and remove its CEO and board.

title: WisdomTree gets SEC approval for round-the-clock trading of tokenized MMF
summary: The approval allows WisdomTree’s tokenized Treasury money market fund to trade and settle around the clock within the US regulatory framework.

title: Binance CEO hints at legal action over report on Iranian sanctions
summary: Two major news outlets published similar reports on Monday claiming that Binance had fired or suspended employees involved in an investigation into crypto going to Iranian entities.

title: What NYSE’s exploration of onchain systems means for financial markets
summary: Tokenized securities, 24/7 trading and onchain settlement could allow the NYSE’s blockchain plans to reshape post-trade processes in financial markets.
